info.title: The Shiunji Family Children
info.synopsis: I due fratelli e le cinque sorelle della famiglia Shiunji brillano come gemme, ciascuno dotato di un'intelligenza e una bellezza al di fuori del comune. Con alle spalle un "pedigree" dato dall'immensa ricchezza del padre è impossibile per loro non essere sulla bocca di tutti. Il figlio maggiore, Arata, ha passato la vita ad essere sballottato dai capricci delle sue eccentriche sorelle ma nonostante questo la famiglia continua ad essere la cosa che ritiene più importante. Ma quando la sorella più piccola compie quindici anni, il padre rivela un segreto a lungo nascosto sconvolgendo totalmente la vita di Arata...

episodes.title: Episodio 7

info.title: Princess-Session Orchestra
info.synopsis: Gli abitanti di Alipecia sono un popolo che ama il divertimento, ma un giorno improvvisamente spuntano dei misteriosi mostri chiamati Jamaok che minacciano la pace del regno. Un trio di "principesse" che non ha dimenticano mai la canzone all'interno dei propri cuori anche di fronte a qualsiasi pericolo, si fanno avanti per salvare Alipecia grazie al potere della musica.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Sorano Minamo visits a live event held in the mysterious land of Alicepia together with her best friend, Hinomoto Natsu. However, the venue is suddenly attacked by a mysterious monster. At that moment, Minamo witnesses the appearance of a “Princess,” a figure who sings and dances to vanquish the creature.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Sorano Minamo transforms into Princess Ripple but continues to struggle against monsters due to her inexperience. Just then, Princess Zeal, whom she saw recently at a concert venue, comes to her rescue and saves the day. The true identity of Princess Zeal is Shirube Kagari, who happens to be Hinomoto Natsu's idol and someone she deeply admires. Minamo learns more about the Princesses and the monsters known as Jammerwock from Kagari.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Having decided to become Princess Ripple and protect Alicepia, Sorano Minamo begins following senior princess Shirube Kagari around to get advice from her. Meanwhile, in Alicepia, a new threat emerges as a boy named Guita releases a Jammerwock, following the actions of Bess.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: One day, Sorano Minamo meets her favorite streamer, Ichijou Nagase. She is then invited to a small-scale live concert held after school at Alicepia. While Nagase is preparing for the performance at Alicepia, the third enemy, Drun, appears and unleashes a Jammerwock to attack her.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Kira Kira (Sparkle). That shine created by people is what Nagase values most. However, feeling a disconnect between her own sparkle and that of the Princesses, she grows disheartened. Overwhelmed by self-doubt, Nagase becomes unable to continue her activities with Alicepia, even if only temporarily.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: In absolutely unstoppable form — to the point that even Princess Ripple and Princess Zeal are left speechless — Princess Meteor effortlessly takes down the Jammerwock. Still buzzing with excitement, she proposes a get-together that serves as a wrap party, victory celebration, and team mixer all rolled into one. Karaoke, tea, shopping—Minamo and the rest take full advantage of the day off to dive into the festivities of the wrap party… and everything else you’d expect on a fun-filled break day.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Bess continues producing Jammerwocks of various types—Pawn, Knight, Bishop—and it seems she has successfully created a new model once again. As Sorano Minamo and her friends enjoy a girls’ gathering at Ichijou Nagase’s home, the conversation blooms into a lively talk about their families. However, in the midst of the cheerful tea party, an emergency dispatch request suddenly arrives from Naviyu.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: The mysterious group known as Band Snatch continues to grow stronger. In response, Minamo and her friends search for ways to power up. Their conclusion: instead of each singing separately, they should perform as a chorus. The princesses form a unit and immediately begin their training. However, Princess Ripple becomes aware that she is the only one dragging the team down, which troubles her deeply.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: By the way, Sorano Minamo's hobby is baking sweets. Inspired by this, she decides to try creating and streaming her own videos. However, things don't go smoothly, and she keeps running into trouble due to her inexperience. To cheer herself up, Minamo heads to an event featuring her favorite sweets streamer, Sato Kaede. But as usual, at the event venue, she encounters Jammerwock and Guita.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: On the way home from Natsu's street performance in Alicepia, Minamo and her friends encounters a girl who tries to create a new dance move combined with both martial arts and music called Himura Mikan. Inspired by Natsu and Mikan, who enjoys their Alicepian activities, Minamo and her friends decide to make herself a main star.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: First off, who are Jammerwocks and Band Snatch? In order to find the answers, Naviyu search for the old documents in the library. Meanwhile, in the Princess Room, a tea party is being held with sweets made by Minamo.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: One of the twins were saved, but the Princesses need to save the other one by challenging Calisto for a fight. However, even the three of them were no match for Calisto's power and they were forced to detransform at one point.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: Just as the Princesses trying to discover the true identity of Jammerwocks, and by extension the Band Snatch, the villainous band group also trying to investigate the girls in order to find an efficient way to retrieve Musessence. And what method they will use?

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: One day during a lunch break, Minamo and her friends met Hakase Manabi, a genius inventor from next class and a friend of Natsu who has strong sense of who she wants to express through Alicepia, and is the kind of a girl who wants to root for.

episodes.title: Episodio 15
episodes.synopsis: On their day off, Minamo and her friends went to Sorami Tower in the morning. By chance, they meet Kazahana Sumire, a senior member of Kagari's library committee. A mature and gentle senior student, Minamo aspires to be like Sumire.

episodes.title: Episodio 16
episodes.synopsis: Nagase's classmate, Tanaka Mai, captivated the audience with her dancing. However, there's trouble coming on her, which turns out to be related to Nagase.

episodes.title: Episodio 17
episodes.synopsis: Kagari is worried about her classmate Hasegawa Hayate, who has been feeling down lately. But when Kagari asked her about it, Hayate just gave her a vague laugh and brushes it off. However, Drun then steals Musessence from Hayate. As the Princesses rush towards the scene and began fighting, Kagari heard Hayate's voice coming from a Jammerwock.

episodes.title: Episodio 18
episodes.synopsis: Minamo's mother, Yoko, also visited Alicepia when she was a child. Hearing Yoko's childhood stories made Minamo's love for Alicepia become even more intense. However, Calisto appears before Minamo.

episodes.title: Episodio 19
episodes.synopsis: To Kagari, Alicepia was an endlessly free and kind world where she was seen as just a normal girl, with nothing special about her. Meanwhile, the Band Snatch's secret operation has finally come to light while Guita himself challenged the Princesses for a fight without a help from Jammerwock.

episodes.title: Episodio 20
episodes.synopsis: Nagase goes on a date with her fan Aiko. Even though they're having a great time, Aiko seems to be worried of Alicepia, who has been acting dangerous lately. But Nagase encourages Aiko by telling her that the Princesses will defeat the villains. At the time, Nagase saw Bess in the town and ended up being lured out by him.

episodes.title: Episodio 21
episodes.synopsis: Minamo is gradually getting used to filming her baking videos. But suddenly, her cooking idol Sato Kaede suddenly appears. As two girls with same hobby, Minamo and Kaede began their own conversation where she learns about Kaede's love for Alicepia. However, Drun appears.

episodes.title: Episodio 22
episodes.synopsis: Minamo and her friends are excited when their friend Natsu held her own solo concert that isn't on the street. However, during the midst of their joy, the rest of the Band Snatch all appear at the same time. When the Band Snatch finally shown their true strength, the Princesses' songs had no effect on them, which they're overwhelmed and ultimately defeated.

episodes.title: Episodio 23
episodes.synopsis: Now that they've recovered, Minamo and her friends head back to Alicepia for their final showdown with the Band Snatch. Transformed, the Princesses put up a fierce fight against the Band Snatch, whom they have once defeated. However, the difference in strength is still insurmountable. Still, the three refused to give up before they heard a song reached into their ears.

episodes.title: Episodio 24
episodes.synopsis: After the Princesses defeat the Band Snatch with their newfound powers, the mastermind behind the allegations appears before them: the Red Queen, ruler of Alicepia. The Queen said, "For Alicepia to survive, one must be strong." This is why she is giving them trials, in order to encourage their evolution.

episodes.title: Episodio 25
episodes.synopsis: Kisaragi Botan has always been fascinated by princesses. After all, the fighting heroines she has admired since she was little actually exist. Wanting to become a princess herself, Botan decides to start by becoming one.

episodes.title: Episodio 26
episodes.synopsis: After overcoming the decisive battle with the Red Queen, peace finally seems to have returned to Alicepia. However, the Jammerwocks still continue to appear. While the mystery remains, no answers have been found, and so for the time being, everyone continues to go about their daily lives. However, Alicepia won't let the Princesses rest.

episodes.title: Episodio 27
episodes.synopsis: The Princesses defeat the strange white creature who calls herself Flower Knight Sincere. The danger to Alicepia is not over, and they are understandably disheartened. But today is Natsu's long-awaited live concert, so they shift their focus and head to the venue. Naturally, it is Flower Knight Sincere who reaches out her evil hand towards this happy stage.

episodes.title: Episodio 28
episodes.synopsis: Minamo and the others accompany Kagari to the Central Library in Alicepia to return a borrowed book. By chance, they meet their senior, Sumire, there. They learn that she regularly visits the library and has a habit of reading books to the Alicepians.

episodes.title: Episodio 29
episodes.synopsis: Sumire is Sincere's true identity. Believing there must be some reason behind it, Minamo and the others try to probe the matter discreetly later, but Sumire gives nothing away. To dispel the gloomy mood, Minamo and the others head out to play at Natsu's suggestion. While thoroughly enjoying Alicepia, Jammerwocks and Sincere appear once more, targeting Musessence.

episodes.title: Episodio 30
episodes.synopsis: As Sumire gets ready for break period, Kagari approaches her wanting to talk. Sumire agrees and suggests they move somewhere else. Kagari takes her to a stairwell where Minamo and others are waiting, with Natsu keeping watch. Kagari, troubled, admits she can't believe Sumire is Sincere and wishes it was just a dream. Sumire gently tells her that it's real, calling her "Princess Zeal". Worried, Kagari asks how long Sumire has known, and Sumire reveals she's always known, then recalls the timeline of their awakenings.

episodes.title: Episodio 31
episodes.synopsis: Furumi Eru is a member of the drama club. She wants to perform a play about a Princess, so she runs around Alicepia to gather materials. But her bright and sparkling personality makes a target for Flower Knight Purity, Lily.

episodes.title: Episodio 32
episodes.synopsis: Even if the White Queen's intentions are good, it's still wrong to attack a girl on purpose. As Princesses, they have to keep fighting. That being said, it has been decided that Minamo and her friends will perform a street live show.

episodes.title: Episodio 33
episodes.synopsis: One day, Minamo discovers a video of Lily and an Alicepian are dancing happily. After discussing it together, the main group decides to head to the location where the video was filmed to gather any information they could find. But suddenly, they find Lily and Sumire there.

episodes.title: Episodio 34
episodes.synopsis: Unable to withstand the ever-increasing Musessence, Alicepians will disintegrate. Upon learning this shocking truth from Sumire, Minamo and the others come to understand the reason why the Kazahana sisters fight. For the sorrow of losing their beloved Alicepians is no longer something that could never happen to them.

episodes.title: Episodio 35
episodes.synopsis: The Princesses attempt to persuade Purity, but Purity's heart is stubbornly closed and her blades are powerful enough to surpass them. However, Sumire is the only one who can stop Purity's madness. As her older sister, Sumire conveys her sincere feelings for Lily, melting her icy heart.

episodes.title: Episodio 36
episodes.synopsis: Though everyone celebrated the birth of the new Princesses, the Kazahana sisters, regretting their past actions, refused to join them willingly. The Kazahana sisters vowed to protect Alicepia as Princesses in their own right. Classmate Matsuri Furano smiled at Sumire, while Natsu, unable to leave her be, attempted to engage with Lily.

episodes.title: Episodio 37
episodes.synopsis: Since the Kazahana sisters are still distant from the others, Minamo and her friends plan a date. And through smooth talking and clever maneuvering, they managed to make a promise with the sisters. When they arrive at the aquarium, everyone has a great time.

episodes.title: Episodio 38
episodes.synopsis: Everyone starts working to make the Princess Festival that Matsuri planned a reality. Everyone will also be performing live on stage, so they are practicing hard every day. Meanwhile, Natsu is having a discussion with the Kazahana sisters.

episodes.title: Episodio 39
episodes.synopsis: The PriFes has finally begun, reaching its peak right from the start. The girls Minamo and the others have met are participating with various performances. And Minamo and the others await the Kazahana sisters. On the stage Natsu has prepared, to sing together.

episodes.title: Episodio 40
episodes.synopsis: At the climax of the PriFes, the White Queen finally takes action. She lures the Princesses into her lair where she reveals the shocking truth.

episodes.title: Episodio 41
episodes.synopsis: The Princesses, now transformed, confront the White Queen in a decisive battle. Yet the White Queen's full might proved overwhelming, surpassing even that. At the Princess Festival venue, everyone desperately holds back the Jammersnark. Without relying on the Princesses, relying solely on their own strength.

episodes.title: Episodio 42
episodes.synopsis: Minamo and the others savored the return of peaceful days at last. Yet a worry lingered: Naviyu had not been seen since that incident. Then, as if on cue, a strange phenomenon occurred. Phantoms of Alicepians began appearing in Minamo's world.

episodes.title: Episodio 43
episodes.synopsis: The Red Queen has already vanished, so why is the Band Snatch here? The Princesses are bewildered, yet the Band Snatch launches their attack regardless.

episodes.title: Episodio 44
episodes.synopsis: Having absorbed the Musessence of the Red and White Queens, Naviyu proclaims himself King and declares war. His goal is simple: the domination of Alicepia. With their Princess powers taken away, Minamo and the others spend several days utterly helpless. Meanwhile, a mysterious tower suddenly appeared in Alicepia.

episodes.title: Episodio 45
episodes.synopsis: Guided by the sisters who have returned as Flower Knights, Minamo and the others confront the Band Snatch at the tower's summit. Though the Flower Knights fight valiantly, they are still no match for the Band Snatch. Trapped in a desperate situation, Minamo and the others realise: A Princess is born only after one has heightened their Musessence.

episodes.title: Episodio 46
episodes.synopsis: Entrusted with the true intent and feelings of the Band Snatch, the Princesses confront Naviyu. Leaving the copies of the Red and White Queens to the sisters, Ripple and the others fight to engage Naviyu in dialogue. The three who stood closest to Naviyu unleash their feelings through song and fists.

episodes.title: Episodio 47
episodes.synopsis: A hymn of destruction. A song of invasion. Carol was the calamity that the former Princesses had once driven away, and which the Red and White Queens feared would return. A natural phenomenon devoid of any human intent or malice, destined merely to obliterate all that exists. As a result, the worlds of Alicepia and Minamo's have merged, and Jammerwocks are appearing endlessly throughout the city.

episodes.title: Episodio 48
episodes.synopsis: The Princesses and Band Snatch set out to defeat the Jammerwocks, but Carol is determined to create even more of them. Natsu appeals to the people via a live stream. The world’s rallying cry: Musessence. Let’s increase the joy and fun that give rise to it, she says.

episodes.title: Nuovi amici
episodes.synopsis: 一文字博士のもと、ボルゾイスクールでマシンを走らせていた烈矢と豪樹兄弟。しかし、自分の走りを博士に認めてもらえぬ豪樹はスクールを出る。そんな豪樹の前に和男という少年が現れた。彼はミニ四駆で遊ぶ少年に次々と勝負を挑み、マシンを奪っていたのだ。卑劣なやり方に怒った豪樹は、和男との勝負を受けて立つ。

episodes.title: Che avventura!
episodes.synopsis: 源さんの経営するGEN製作所に住み込むことになった豪樹。世界一のミニ四レーサーを目指す豪樹はWGPで優勝したビクトリーズの豪に勝負を挑もうとする。第二回WGP開催地のアメリカに向けて旅立つビクトリーズの壮行会に乱入した豪樹は、コースアウトしマックスブレイカーをバラバラにしてしまうのだった…。

episodes.title: Gara in famiglia
episodes.synopsis: 豪樹が飛び出したボルゾイスクールの理念は「レースは戦い」というもの。「強さこそがミニ四駆」と固く信じる烈矢は、勝負を挑もうと兄の豪樹を捜す。一方、豪樹は町の模型店でボルゾイスクールのレーサーを負かし、ひとしという少年の挑戦を受ける。レースは豪樹の作ったコースで行われることになるのだが…？

episodes.title: Una sfida misteriosa
episodes.synopsis: ひとしたちに強いレーサーがいると聞いた豪樹は、勝負を挑みにビル建設現場に設置されたコースへと向かう。高難度なコースを見つけた豪樹は早速自分のマシンを走らせるが、そこにマリナという少女が現れる。豪樹のマシンを見た途端、マリナは怒りに燃えた態度で「ボルゾイのレーサーか？」と豪樹に詰め寄るのだった。

episodes.title: La legge della scuola Borzoi
episodes.synopsis: 豪樹がGEN製作所で穏やかな日々を過ごす一方で、烈矢はボルゾイスクールで厳しい特訓を受けていた。Aクラストップの成績の烈矢はSクラスに上がるため、Sクラスのレーサーと勝負する。勝負に勝った烈矢はSクラス入りを果たすが…。

episodes.title: La squadra di difesa del quartiere
episodes.synopsis: ボルゾイスクールのレーサーたちがあちこちのコースを荒らし回っていると聞き、豪樹たちは「町内防衛隊」を結成。コース荒らしの犯人は烈矢たちボルゾイスクールの連中だった。そんな烈矢たちを陰から狙う4人組。その正体は、烈矢に負け、Aクラスに落ちたトオルたちだった。豪樹たちは烈矢たちとトオルたちのいざこざに巻き込まれ…。

episodes.title: La campionessa
episodes.synopsis: グレートジャパンカップ・ウィンターレースの存在を知った豪樹。世界一を目指すにはまず日本一だ！ということで、レース出場へ。大会当日、会場には和男やマリナの姿もあり俄然張り切る豪樹。そしてレース開始!! ボルゾイの連中に恨みを持つマリナはファイヤースティンガーで攻撃を仕掛けるが…。

episodes.title: Un pilota per due macchine
episodes.synopsis: 2台のマシンを操ってボルゾイのレーサーを敗った少年が現れた!! その噂を聞いた豪樹は早速その少年、一馬に勝負を挑もうとして隣町まで出かける。が、本人に会えなかった豪樹は一馬の弟、力に果たし状を渡して帰る。豪樹の期待通り、挑戦を受けた一馬は指定された自動車工場跡地に現れた！ 勝負の結果は果たして…!?

episodes.title: Cento avversari
episodes.synopsis: ボルゾイスクールが主催する初めてのレース、ボルゾイオープンが開かれることになった。レース開催までの1ヶ月の間、Sクラスのレーサーたちは特別なメニューで鍛え直されることに。烈矢は、レースは自分1人で十分だとSクラスのレーサーたちに100台抜きを挑むのだが、負けたら烈矢はスクールをやめなければならず…。

episodes.title: La macchina a razzo
episodes.synopsis: ボルゾイにSクラスのトップレーサー、左京が帰ってきた。烈矢は早速勝負を持ちかけるが、マックスブレイカーの方に興味がある左京は応じない。そのマックスブレイカーの持ち主、豪樹に会いに行った左京は、高速サーキットでのレースを申し込む。試合当日、ストレートでスピードを競い合う左京と豪樹であったが…。

episodes.title: Il sistema vincente
episodes.synopsis: 左京に負けた豪樹は、マックスブレイカーで必殺技をあみ出そうと決心。早速マシンにロケットをとりつけるが、あっけなく失敗、一からやり直すことに。一方、烈矢は左京に勝負を持ちかけるが「君のマシンには興味がない」とあっさり断られてしまう。GEN製作所に戻った豪樹は山さんに必殺技の相談をするのだった。

episodes.title: Un inizio difficile
episodes.synopsis: ついに必殺技「マックスストーム」をあみ出した豪樹は、ボルゾイ・オープンでの優勝を狙って特訓に励む。一方、謎の少女マリナもレースに招待され、打倒ボルゾイを誓う。レース当日、烈矢、左京、マリナ、一馬たち強豪がそろう中、豪樹は遅刻ギリギリ、なんとか会場に滑り込む。だが慌てていたため思わぬトラブルが!?

episodes.title: Il torneo prosegue
episodes.synopsis: 他のレーサーよりも300秒遅れてスタートしたマリナ、大善兄弟、左京そして烈矢と豪樹。前方グループを追い上げるが、初速の遅いマックスブレイカーは濁流に飲み込まれてしまう。だが間一髪、豪樹は必殺技「マックスストーム」を使ってピンチを脱出。一方、ボルゾイのレーサーたちは一般参加レーサーの妨害をし…。

episodes.title: Vittoria!
episodes.synopsis: ボルゾイオープンも大詰めを迎えた。トップを争うのはマリナと左京。一方、烈矢と豪樹も熾烈な争いを繰り広げる。烈矢は得意のプラズマ攻撃で豪樹を敗ろうとするが、マリナとの死闘でマシンがトラブルを起こし、上手くプラズマを放射することができない。対する豪樹はマックスストームで烈矢を追い抜くのだが…？

episodes.title: Un grande pilota
episodes.synopsis: ボルゾイオープンでマックスストームの威力を見せつけた豪樹。その豪樹に敗れた烈矢は、再び豪樹に戦いを挑んでくる。マックスブレイカーの秘密を探ろうとするひとしたちが見守る中、烈矢のリターンマッチが始まった！ 烈矢に大差をつけられてファイナルラップを迎えた豪樹は、ついにマックスストームを放つ！

episodes.title: La corsa in città
episodes.synopsis: 製作所裏のコースに飽きた豪樹たちは自分たちでコースを作ることに。新しくGEN製作所の居候となった烈矢も手伝って、ものすごいコースが完成！ 大善兄弟、マリナも加わり、一大レースが始まった！ コース全体がどうなっているのかも分からないままマシンは一斉にスタート。製作所の皆もエビフライを賭け優勝者を予想する！

episodes.title: La sfida di Sandro
episodes.synopsis: ボルゾイオープンで豪樹に負けた左京は、再び豪樹に1対1の勝負を挑む。だが、そのことを知った烈矢は豪樹に内緒でレース場へ行き左京に挑戦。試合は圧倒的に左京がリードし、烈矢は自分の走りに焦りを覚える。「自分の走りを見つけた」という豪樹の言葉がよぎる烈矢。そこへ豪樹が現れ、左京とのレースがスタートする！

episodes.title: Una gara esplosiva
episodes.synopsis: シャドウブレイカーの改良に精を出す烈矢は、勢い余って風呂場を破壊。GEN製作所のみんなは銭湯に出かけるはめに。だが、何を勘違いしたのか烈矢と豪樹は銭湯でレースを始めてしまう。女湯に来ていたマリナとミナミも水着でレースに参加。ついに、ジャングル風呂に特設ステージが現れ、大人たちも巻き込んでの大混戦に！

episodes.title: Il nemico invisibile
episodes.synopsis: GEN製作所で暮らす烈矢のもとに、ボロボロのダミーのZ-3が送られてきた。マシンには「3日後」と書かれたメモが…。不気味なマシンとメモは毎日烈矢に送られ、豪樹たちは見えない相手に不安を覚える。傷つけられたマシンとメモから送り主は烈矢のZ-3を狙っていることが判明し、やがて果たし状ともとれる予告状が…。

episodes.title: Chi è il nemico?
episodes.synopsis: 謎の少年、漸にZ-3をボロボロにされた烈矢。何とか自力で直そうとするが、ボディはズタズタ、電装系も故障し、烈矢の力では直りそうもない。そんな姿を見た豪樹は手を貸そうとするが、烈矢は頑として応じないのだった。漸に対して怒りを覚えた豪樹は勝負を仕掛けに行くが、既に豪樹にも漸から予告状が出されていた！

episodes.title: Gli avversari sono due
episodes.synopsis: 漸と豪樹の戦いの場に烈矢が現れた瞬間、漸は煙とともに消えてしまう。マシンを直し、改めて勝負を仕掛けにいった豪樹はまたもや2台のマシンに翻弄される。豪樹と烈矢が漸と思った少年は、実は漸の双子の兄弟、陣であった。2人の目的は、烈矢と豪樹が二度とミニ四駆のレースが出来ないようにすることだっだのだ！

episodes.title: Una strana alleanza
episodes.synopsis: 草薙兄弟に負け、おまけに高熱を出して寝込む豪樹。一方烈矢は草薙兄弟にリターンマッチを挑もうとするが、1人では無理と悟り、マリナにペアを組んでくれるように申し出る。だがボルゾイを恨むマリナは、自分に勝てば条件を呑むと烈矢に勝負を仕掛けてきた！ フレイムバードを仕掛けてくるマリナに対し烈矢は…？

episodes.title: Una nuova sfida contro i gemelli
episodes.synopsis: 烈矢が繰り出した新必殺技は、草薙兄弟のマシンに命中出来ずにファイヤースティンガーに激突、マリナのマシンはバラバラに分解してしまう。一方、烈矢とマリナが草薙兄弟と対決することを知った豪樹は2人を追って決闘の場所に現れる。新たに勝負を挑む烈矢と豪樹に、マリナもマシンを修理してレースに参加するのだった！

episodes.title: I due piloti della classe "C"
episodes.synopsis: 草薙兄弟との戦いに勝利した豪樹と烈矢。そんな2人の前に新たな敵が現れた！ 謎のボルゾイレーサー、ベンジャミンとチャーリーは、豪樹たちに勝負を挑むが、なぜかそのスピードは恐ろしく遅い。呆気にとられる豪樹たちをよそに、ベンジャミンとチャーリーはボルゾイのトップに立つために一文字兄弟を倒すと宣言する！

episodes.title: La Fighter Lady
episodes.synopsis: GEN製作所に新しく女性社員が入ってきた！ サユリというこの女性に製作所の皆は大喜び！ 一見おしとやかに見えるサユリだが、ミニ四駆のコースを見るなりなんだか雰囲気が…。そんなある日、豪樹に「元グレートジャパンカップチャンピオン」と称するナゾの人物からの挑戦状が届く。試合当日に現れたのは何と…！

episodes.title: Un metodo personale!
episodes.synopsis: 製作所の裏のコースで走行する豪樹たちだが、相変わらず烈矢はその輪に加わろうとしない。空き地のコースで1人マシンを走らせる烈矢は、ミニ四駆を始めたばかりの子供たちと出会う。上手くマシンを走らせることができない子供たちにアドバイスをするうちに、烈矢は初めてミニ四駆を手にした時のことを思い出すのだが…。

episodes.title: La gara estiva
episodes.synopsis: 今年もグレートジャパンカップ・サマーレースの時期がやってきた。今回の会場は九州。豪樹は早速源さん、ミナミらとともに九州へ向かった。車での旅の途中、豪樹は名古屋でミニ四駆を走らせている少年、恵一たちに出会い、自分たちと一緒にあるレースに参加してくれと頼まれる。だが、豪樹はその話を断ってしまうのだった。

episodes.title: La gara di gruppo
episodes.synopsis: 源さんに諭されて恵一たちに力を貸すことに決めた豪樹は早速恵一たちのもとへ向かう。そこでは恵一たちがクラッシャーズを相手にマシン3台で悪戦苦闘していた。なんとコースにシーソーが組み込まれ、相手とのバランスを考えて走らなければならない仕組みになっていたのだ！ 「力を合わせて走る」意味を理解した豪樹は…。

episodes.title: Le selezioni per la Great Japan Cup
episodes.synopsis: 大阪にたどり着いた豪樹たちは、大渋滞に巻き込まれ全く動けない状態に。トイレを我慢できずにワゴンを飛び出した豪樹は竜平という少年に出会う。GJCの本戦に出るためには東京地区予選に出場しなければならなかったのだが、竜平の計らいで大阪地区予選に出場できることに。竜平とともにトップを争う豪樹だが…。

episodes.title: Lezioni di tattica
episodes.synopsis: ついに九州にたどり着いた豪樹たち一行だったが、途中の山道で車がエンストしてしまう。源さんがガソリンを取りに行っている間、豪樹は地元からサマーレースに参加する大吾という少年に出会い、勝負をすることに。しかし、状況を読みながらコースにあった走りをする大吾に、豪樹は苦戦を強いられてしまうのだった。

episodes.title: La Great Japan Cup al via
episodes.synopsis: ついにGJCサマーレースが開催!! 豪樹を始め、錚々たるメンバーが九州に集まったが、会場にボルゾイレーサーの姿はなかった…。胸に一抹の不安を抱きつつも、豪樹たちの熱い戦いが始まった！ 豪樹たちは一斉にスタート!! しかし烈矢がトップに踊り出た瞬間、突如大地震が起こり、地下に続く新しいコースが現れる！

episodes.title: Corsa alla cieca
episodes.synopsis: GJCサマーレースがボルゾイに乗っ取られてしまった！ 第2回ボルゾイオープンに巻き込まれた豪樹たちは、地下のトンネル内に閉じ込められてしまい、次々と襲いかかってくる罠に悪戦苦闘する。「ゴールは皆で目指す」という恵一に同調し、豪樹はGJCレーサーの先頭に立って仲間のマシンを引っ張っていくのだが…。

episodes.title: Vittoria finale
episodes.synopsis: コースが分からず戸惑っている豪樹たちの前に謎の少年が現れ、道案内をかって出る。いちかばちか、豪樹たちはこの少年についていくことに。無事地上に出ることができた豪樹たちだが、そのコースはなんと火山に続くものだった！ 今度こそ草薙兄弟を倒すため、烈矢と豪樹は連携して勝負を挑む。果たして勝利は誰の手に!?

episodes.title: Una nuova compagna per Robin
episodes.synopsis: ファントムブレードと差し違え、まっぷたつになってしまったZ-3。烈矢はマシンを失ったショックからなかなか立ち直ることができない。一方、一文字博士からの謎のアタッシュケースを開けることができずに悪戦苦闘をしていたミナミたち。だが、ケースに付いている勾玉型のくぼみに豪樹と烈矢の首飾りをはめ込んだ瞬間…！

episodes.title: Robin e la sua nuova Knuckle Breaker
episodes.synopsis: ついに烈矢のニューマシン、ナックルブレイカーが完成！ 烈矢はマシンの走りを一文字博士に見てもらおうと、ボルゾイスクールを訪れる。だが、博士はボルゾイに軟禁されており、烈矢たちに会うことができない。一方、烈矢のマシンがナックルブレイカーであることを知ったボルゾイは、その走りを見ようと勝負を申し出る！

episodes.title: L'arrivo dei campioni americani
episodes.synopsis: アメリカのミニ四駆大会、スーパーナショナルチャンピオンシリーズの決勝ファイナルステージが日本で開かれることになり、豪樹たちも参加することに。未だにうまく能力を発揮できないまま烈矢もナックルブレイカーで勝負に挑むが、いきなり出遅れたのはアメリカ人レーサーたち。日本勢は彼らに勝つことができるのか？

episodes.title: La corsa sulla portaerei
episodes.synopsis: アメリカ人レーサーに負けた豪樹たちは次の試合に向け、マシンの走行練習に余念が無い。豪樹がマリナと一緒にマシンを走らせる一方で、烈矢はZ-1の走りをモノにしようと必死になる。マックスブレイカーとは違う空気の層が発生するZ-1を、「音速を超えようとしているジェット機」と例えるヤマさんの言葉に烈矢は…。

episodes.title: Il segreto di Robin e George
episodes.synopsis: 烈矢のミスで大事なものを下水道に落としてしまった一文字兄弟！ 早速マシンに防水処理を施し、カメラとヘッドライトを付けて捜索を始める。お宝探しと聞いてミナミたちも後を追うが、またまた烈矢のせいで今度はマシンまで見失ってしまう!! 仕方なく自力で下水道を探す豪樹たち。やがてマシンとお宝にたどり着くが…！

episodes.title: Il ritorno delle gare estive
episodes.synopsis: 川下模型店10周年記念大ミニ四駆レースが開催されることになった。レース実況に燃えるサユリは、早速全国のレーサーたちに招待状を出す。順調に予選を勝ち抜いた豪樹たち。烈矢と竜平は路面が乾くのを待ってスパークする作戦に。一方の豪樹は路面のコンディションに合わせレインタイヤにしてトップをキープする。

episodes.title: L'arrivo di Nero Stella Borzoi
episodes.synopsis: ボルゾイの孫、ネロが日本にやってきた。ボルゾイのもとへ向かう途中ひとしに出会ったネロは、彼のマシンの改造に手を貸す。ひとしは早速そのマシンで豪樹たちに勝負を挑み、必殺技で勝利を得た。ひとしのマシンの驚くべき変貌に呆然とする豪樹と烈矢。一方、ネロはボルゾイスクールを訪れ、草薙兄弟に勝負を挑まれる！

episodes.title: Marina rivede suo padre
episodes.synopsis: 買い物に出かけたミナミは、偶然一文字博士と出会う。それを不審に思った豪樹たちはボルゾイスクールに連絡を取るが、何と博士はボルゾイを辞めていたのだった。一方マリナは黒服の男たちにボルゾイスクールに連れて行かれ、父親、大神博士から「自分の作ったマシンを生かせるのはおまえだけだ」と言われるのだった。

episodes.title: L'incubo comincia
episodes.synopsis: ボルゾイ・ネロの下で研究を続ける大神博士。ネロは速さも強さも兼ね備えた究極のマシンを作らせようとしているのだった。一心不乱に設計に取り組む大神博士は、マリナに「豪樹たちのZマシンを潰してこい」と命令する。博士の命を受け、豪樹に挑むマリナ。そのレースは今までの彼女の走りとは全く違うものだった。

episodes.title: La macchinina più forte del mondo
episodes.synopsis: ついにネロのニューマシン、ディオマースが完成。一方豪樹と烈矢は、マリナとのレースで壊れたマックスブレイカーの修理に必死になっていた。しかし、豪樹の不注意からマシンは修理不可能に。一文字博士に相談しに行った烈矢は、マックスブレイカーの再生に必要なスプレーがボルゾイのもとに保管されていることを知る。

episodes.title: La nascita della nuova Max Breaker
episodes.synopsis: 生まれ変わった新・マックスブレイカーを走らせる豪樹の前に突然現れた少年。マックスブレイカーと並び、ライジングトリガーを走らせるのは何とビクトリーズの鷹羽リョウだった!! あっさりリョウに負けてしまった豪樹に対し「豪樹はマシンのポテンシャルを引き出せていない」と判断するリョウであったが…。

episodes.title: La gara d'autunno
episodes.synopsis: オータムレースが開催された！ 豪樹、烈矢、ネロたちはそれぞれのマシンで激しい戦いを繰り広げる。だが、レース途中でネロのマシンが恐ろしい力を発揮、コースそのものが崩れてしまう!! 究極のマシンを手に入れたネロは、オータムレースの中止を告知し、新たに「M1」なるレースを開催することを宣言するのだった。

episodes.title: La riunione dei grandi: comincia la M1
episodes.synopsis: M1レース開幕に向け全国から強豪レーサーが集まり、竜平、大吾らが豪樹のもとへ転がり込んできた。1万人の中から本戦に出られるのはたったの5人!! マリナもボルゾイのレーサーとして予選に参加するが、他のマシンを蹴散らす荒い走りで豪樹たちを失望させるのだった。豪樹たちは無事予選を通過できるのか!?

episodes.title: Uno contro uno
episodes.synopsis: M1レースも終盤に突入。だが、トップグループは草薙兄弟の妨害に苦しんでいた。突然レースに加わった左京とともにトップグループでゴールを目指す豪樹。烈矢は草薙兄弟の攻撃を受けながらも何とか一次予選を通過。豪樹らとともに臨む二次予選のレースは1対1のマッチレース。勝者が決勝レースに進むというものだった。

episodes.title: Semaforo verde per lo scontro decisivo
episodes.synopsis: 決勝レース出場メンバーが決まった豪樹、烈矢、ひとし、竜平、左京、大吾の5人は一週間後のレースに備え、それぞれに準備を進める。一方、大神博士は草薙兄弟のマシンにMGストーンを搭載、最後の調整に入っていた。マシンの完成に満足げな博士だが、マリナはマシンを走らせることの意味を見いだせないでいた…。

episodes.title: Un triste inizio
episodes.synopsis: ついにM1決勝レースが開催された！ トップを走るのはネロ。豪樹たちは草薙兄弟に邪魔され思うように進むことができない。一方最後尾を走っていたマリナはパワーアップしたマシンで草薙兄弟と対決。2人のマシンを破壊する。バトルレースを続けるマリナに、左京と竜平はミニ四駆を走らせることの楽しさを必死で訴え…。

episodes.title: La corsa più straordinaria della storia
episodes.synopsis: M1レースも中盤を迎え、各選手はマシンのメンテナンスにとりかかる。マシンの調整をするマリナの脳裏には竜平と左京の言葉が離れない。メンテナンスを終えたマリナは、豪樹たちと正々堂々勝負することを宣言、マシンから凶器を取り除く。一方、ネロは草薙兄弟に行く手を阻まれ、MGストーンのパワーを全開にする！

episodes.title: La vittoria finale
episodes.synopsis: M1レースもいよいよ決着の時を迎える！ トップを走るのはネロ。その後に豪樹と烈矢が続き、3人の熾烈な争いが繰り広げられる。ゴール近くで烈矢がネロを抜きトップに踊りでるが、豪樹も負けじと追い上げる。2人を追うネロはマースグラビティで豪樹たちのマシンを狙おうとするが…！ 果たして勝利は誰の手に!?

info.synopsis: "Che peccato... che spreco... se mi arrenderò sarà tutto vano, se rinuncerò sarà stato tutto tempo sprecato!"

info.title: Ken il Guerriero - La Trilogia (ITA)
info.synopsis: In una Terra post-apocalittica, l'acqua è diventata completamente tossica, ad eccezione di una parte scoperta recentemente da alcuni abitanti. Purtroppo per loro, anche un potente uomo di nome Sanga desidera l'acqua e pur di ottenerla è pronto ad uccidere chiunque grazie all'aiuto della sua banda di assassini. Proprio durante uno dei suoi crimini, però, compare un uomo di nome Kenshiro determinato a fermarlo grazie al suo talento per le arti marziali.

episodes.title: La Leggenda di Hokuto
episodes.synopsis: La storia si svolge al momento dell'incontro di Kenshiro con Shu e lo scontro con Souther; il fulcro della storia è però su Raoul, visto dagli occhi di Souga e Reina, un fratello e una sorella che Raoul ha conosciuto da bambino nella Terra degli Shura prima di partire per andare da Ryuken; giunti quando Raoul ha cominciato la sua guerra di conquista, i due sono diventati i suoi generali. Souga organizza un tentativo di assassinio sventato da Reina e viene condannato a morte; in realtà lo scopo è tenere Raoul focalizzato e vigile, e Raoul lo comprende decidendo di guardare da lontano la sua pira funebre; Reina è innamorata di Raoul, concentrato solo sulla conquista e probabilmente cieco ai sentimenti di lei; eppure, Reina è testimone del profondo ma contorto rapporto di Raoul con i due fratelli minori (lo stesso Kenshiro e Toki), mostrato prima nel salvare Kenshiro dalle ferite dopo la sua fuga, poi nel recarsi al mausoleo di Souther.

episodes.title: La Leggenda di Julia
episodes.synopsis: Questo OVA presenta una trama piuttosto originale perché presenta la storia dal punto di vista di Yuria, che spazia dalla sua infanzia, incluso il giorno in cui ha incontrato per la prima volta Kenshiro, alla conclusione del film precedente, così come alcune scene del manga e dell'anime in cui Yuria non era presente. Questa storia è la più estesa della serie, coprendo anche eventi mai visti prima dell'infanzia di Yuria, rivelando sia sua madre che suo padre, così come suo fratello Ryuuga durante la sua infanzia. Aggiunge anche alcuni dettagli che non erano nel manga, come il momento e il luogo in cui Yuria ha sviluppato la sua malattia, il suo incontro con Rei (che fa la sua unica apparizione nella serie) e la sua transizione al ruolo di Generale di Nanto. Una delle aggiunte più notevoli è il cane di Yuria, Tobi, che svolge un ruolo importante nella relazione tra lei e Ken. Tuttavia, l'OVA termina con la morte di Souther e non segue Yuria fino al momento della sua morte.

episodes.title: La Leggenda di Raoul
episodes.synopsis: Un adattamento cinematografico dell'arco narrativo dell'Ultimo generale di Nanto tratto dal manga, che raffigura la battaglia finale tra Kenshiro e Raoh che ha portato Kenshiro a diventare il successore di Hokuto Shinken. Alcuni eventi del manga/anime sono stati esclusi dalla storia (come la lotta di Raoh con Juza), mentre altri sono stati modificati o ampliati. Sono stati aggiunti nuovi contenuti che mostrano la battaglia finale dal punto di vista di Raoh. Questo film funge da seguito al primo film della serie, che ha introdotto la relazione tra Raoh e Reina, questa volta portandola a una conclusione.

info.title: Fermat Kitchen
info.synopsis: Gaku Kitada è un prodigio in matematica e titolare di una borsa di studio all'Accademia Privata Wells, un istituto rinomato con una lunga storia nelle Olimpiadi Matematiche Internazionali, ma ha fallito nel suo percorso di matematico. Dopo una serie di sfortunati eventi, Gaku incontra Kai Asakura, un prodigio nell'arte della cucina che gestisce una sua ditta di catering e decide di portare la matematica nel mondo culinario. Cosa riserva il futuro per questi due geni? E come si intrecceranno le loro strade?

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: After failing at the Mathematics Olympiad and giving up on his dream of becoming a mathematician, Gaku Kitada meets Kai Asakura, a young genius chef, through a plate of spaghetti Napolitan he prepared at the school cafeteria. It is then that a terrible piece of news will turn his life upside down.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: After impressing the benefactors of Wels Academy with his "mathematical method" spaghetti Napolitan, Gaku is invited by Kai to visit his Tokyo restaurant. There, he faces a challenge from Chef Ranna Akamatsu.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Gaku unexpectedly reunites with Kagura Musashi, his childhood friend and former Math Olympiad rival. Disappointed by his decision to leave math behind, she scoffs—until he serves her a dish crafted through logical precision.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Realizing that the path of cooking leads to the "Gate of Truth," Takeru takes the hand of Umi, who boasts that he will "challenge God with cooking." After graduating from school at the top of his class, Takeru moves to Tokyo and begins living with Umi as an apprentice chef at "K." Umi, who has noticed Takeru's fatal weakness, puts him in charge of the meals at "K" and gives him the task of creating meals that will satisfy all the staff within a week. Takeru enters "K" kitchen in high spirits, but is horrified by the harshness of the battlefield.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: 岳がまかない料理として初めて提供した肉じゃがは、“K”のスタッフ全員に認められるものではなかった。スーシェフ（副料理長）である布袋勝也から「人間が見えていない」と厳しい指摘を受けた岳は、正解を見失い失敗を繰り返すなかで、似たような苦境に置かれた同窓生・魚見亜由、そして故郷の味と再会する。思わず涙しそうになった岳が、懐かしい思い出の味から得たインスピレーションとは……？

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: ノスタルジーに甘えない“世界標準の肉じゃが”で、“K”のスタッフを納得させた岳。“K”に迎え入れられた岳はまかないを任せられ、スタッフ間で高く評価されるようになっていく。だが、目まぐるしい日々を過ごすなかで、岳の胸中には焦燥感が渦巻いていた。そんなある日岳に、小学生時代からの友人で、自身が数学者の道を断念するきっかけとなった男・広瀬一太郎との予期せぬ再会の機会が訪れる。

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: 数学の天才・広瀬が招かれる授賞式で、初めてプロとして料理を作ることになった岳。その葛藤を神楽に打ち明け“楽しい”ことの重要性を再確認した岳は、受賞式で提供される料理の担当を決めるコンペティションにおいて、前菜、スープ、肉料理、全パートへのエントリーを宣言する。歳の近い先輩である乾孫六と協力関係を結び、コンペに提出する料理を考案するなかで、岳は彼の意外なルーツを知る。

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: “K”のスタッフによるコンベティションが始まった。渾身のスープを酷評されて孫六がくずおれる一方、岳は香港出身の王明剣、スペイン出身のペーニャ、海を尊崇する宍戸邦彦、そして蘭菜の過去とコンペにかける熱い思いを知る。そして、ついに岳の料理が完成。大胆にも前菜、スープ、肉料理の3品目すべてにエントリーした岳が、海たち審査を担当する料理人たちに差し出したのは、たった一皿だった……！

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: 祝賀会のライブ感を活かし、前菜、スープ、肉料理のすべてを一皿に凝縮してみせた岳。だが海は、岳を布袋に代わりデセール（デザート）担当に抜てきする。祝賀会まで残り3週間。海は岳にパティシエの基本を教え込もうとするが、岳は会心の料理を広瀬に披露する機会を奪われ、作ったこともないデセール担当にされふさぎ込んでしまう。そんななか、思いもよらない訪問者が現れ、岳はデセール担当に抜てきされた思惑を知る。

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: 海にデセールを任された岳は、海の意図をはかりかね、一度はすべてを投げ出して実家に帰ろうとさえ考える。だが彼は、広瀬から送られてきた論文に目を通すと、“K”の厨房へと舞い戻り、デセールの修行を再開するのだった。海と広瀬、2人の天才が抱える絶望的な“孤独”に気づいた岳は、憧れる彼らと同じ道を歩むべく、一段と正確さが求められるパティシエの世界に体力の限界まで挑む。

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: ついに広瀬が参加する授賞式が始まった。蘭菜たちがベストを尽くすなか、岳だけはどこか危うささえ感じさせる様子。デセールの修行を再開してからというもの、店に持ち込まれる食材をあらかた試食した岳は、数日間山梨の実家に帰っていた。布袋、亜由を伴って故郷の地を踏んだ岳は、訪れた植物園で探し求めていた食材を見つけ出す。絶望的な孤独の道を歩み始めた岳が繰り出す、大逆転の一品とは!?

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: 岳が授賞式のために用意したデセールはブランマンジェ。一見何の変哲もないと思われたそれは、食べ進めるごとに食感や味わい、香りまでもが何段階にも移り変わっていくという驚異の逸品だった。「デザートは図形と数字でできている」……そう語る岳のブランマンジェは、広瀬の“真理の扉”を開くことができるのか？そして、岳をパティシエの大海原へと突き落とした海の真の意図が明らかになる……。

Mentre si allena e stringe legami con i suoi compagni Zenitsu Agatsuma e Inosuke Hashibira, Tanjiro affronta numerosi demoni al fianco dei membri più forti del Corpo: i Pilastri (Hashira). Nel corso della sua missione, combatte insieme al Pilastro della Fiamma Kyojuro Rengoku sul Treno Mugen, al Pilastro del Suono Tengen Uzui nel Distretto dei Piaceri, e infine ai Pilastri della Nebbia e dell’Amore – Muichiro Tokito e Mitsuri Kanroji – nel Villaggio dei Fabbri. Con l’inizio dell’addestramento speciale guidato dai Pilastri per prepararsi alla battaglia finale, il capo dei demoni, Muzan Kibutsuji, attacca la sede del Corpo. Tanjiro e gli altri accorrono in aiuto, ma Muzan li trascina in una misteriosa dimensione: il Castello dell’Infinito, la roccaforte dei demoni. Lì ha inizio lo scontro decisivo tra il Corpo Ammazza-Demoni e le forze oscure di Muzan.

episodes.title: Movie 1
episodes.synopsis:
Tanjiro Kamado – a boy who joined an organization dedicated to hunting down demons called the Demon Slayer Corps after his younger sister Nezuko was turned into a demon.

While growing stronger and deepening his friendships and bonds with fellow corps members, Tanjiro has battled many demons with his comrades – Zenitsu Agatsuma and Inosuke Hashibira. Along the way, his journey has led him to fight alongside the Demon Slayer Corps’ highest-ranking swordsmen, the Hashira, including Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku aboard the Mugen Train, Sound Hashira Tengen Uzui within the Entertainment District, as well as Mist Hashira Muichiro Tokito and Love Hashira Mitsuri Kanroji at the Swordsmith Village.

As the Demon Slayer Corps members and Hashira engaged in a group strength training program, the Hashira Training, in preparation for the forthcoming battle against the demons, Muzan Kibutsuji appears at the Ubuyashiki Mansion. With the head of the Demon Corps in danger, Tanjiro and the Hashira rush to the headquarters but are plunged into a deep descent to a mysterious space by the hands of Muzan Kibutsuji.

The destination of where Tanjiro and Demon Slayer Corps have fallen is the demons’ stronghold – the Infinity Castle. And so, the battleground is set as the final battle between the Demon Slayer Corps and the demons ignites.

episodes.synopsis: Il club di teatro cerca di far approvare il copione interspecie. L'interesse di Melon per Haru aumenta. Più tardi Legoshi si riunisce ai suoi amici canidi.

episodes.synopsis: Jack parla con Legoshi delle sue difficoltà a scuola, mentre Yahya fa visita a Deshico in cerca di indizi. L'interesse di Melon per Haru prende una piega pericolosa.

episodes.title: Il rosso nelle nostre vite
episodes.synopsis: Legoshi si sveglia di soprassalto e scopre che Haru è scomparsa. Il sindaco si avvicina a Louis con una succulenta proposta. Pina causa problemi durante le prove.

episodes.title: Dolce sensazione di fame
episodes.synopsis: Juno ha difficoltà a capire il punto di vista degli erbivori e per questo chiede consiglio a Louis. Nel frattempo, al Mercato Nero la situazione diventa sempre più pericolosa.

episodes.title: Su un nido di spaghetti secchi
episodes.synopsis: Un pasto veloce si trasforma in un conflitto morale per Bill. Intanto una serie di inspiegabili attacchi interspecie scuote la città. Louis e Haru passano del tempo insieme.

episodes.title: Caduta felina
episodes.synopsis: La notte dell'Odd Soul Festival, Legoshi incontra Melon a casa di Haru, determinato a fermarlo una volta per tutte... ma il cattivo gli punta contro una pistola.

episodes.title: Devo comprare uno sgabello
episodes.synopsis: Con Melon a piede libero, Legoshi fornisce ad Haru strumenti di autodifesa, ma ha preoccupazioni ben più grandi: su di lui pende un mandato di arresto.

episodes.title: Il Re Demone delle Bestie
episodes.synopsis: Dopo un incontro elettrico, Haru lega con Gosha. Louis confessa alla fidanzata ciò che prova. Melon impone la sua autorità sulla Shishi-Gumi.

episodes.title: Parole sfuggite
episodes.synopsis: Deciso a sfidare Melon, Legoshi partecipa alla guerra territoriale, ma prima deve superare un quiz mortale. Intanto Deshico fa una scoperta cruciale nel suo laboratorio.

episodes.title: Sangue nella palla da discoteca
episodes.synopsis: Il maggiordomo di Louis svela la verità dietro al comportamento di Ogma. Intanto Melon incita la folla e scoppia una rivolta. Riuscirà Legoshi a superare la notte?

episodes.title: Scambio tra le specie
episodes.synopsis: Anche se ha avuto l'approvazione della Doku-Gumi, Legoshi deve comunque affrontare la volpe a capo della Inari-Gumi. Il sindaco sgancia una bomba che prende Louis alla sprovvista.

info.title: Le avventure della dolce Kati (ITA)
info.synopsis: Katori è una bambina finlandese che, dopo la morte improvvisa del padre, si vede separata anche dalla madre che decide di partire per la Germania in cerca di lavoro affidando la ragazzina alle cure dei nonni. L’arrivo della prima guerra mondiale vede le due nazioni su fronti opposti, interrompendo le comunicazioni e quindi tagliando di netto il sussidio economico che la donna mandava alla famiglia rimasta in Scandinavia. Kati decide di iniziare a lavorare come mandriana, impara a filare e tessere e si appassiona ai grandi racconti epici finlandesi.

episodes.title: Il distacco
episodes.synopsis: The story begins as a woman named Sara looks upon her payload as she is taking a carriage ride across the Finnish countryside to where her six-year-old daughter Katri has been residing with her grandparents.

episodes.title: L'amico
episodes.synopsis: The ambiance is tense and awkward Katri awaits her grandfather's return with Aapeli and the calf Juura who seem to have sensed the presence of a deviant diagnostic as if by telepathy; while Katri prepares the sauna galvanized by the prospect of some new clothes, Katri's grandfather Julius struggles to make his way home to repair the damage caused by the bear.

episodes.title: Una primavera tempestosa
episodes.synopsis: An impromptu geography lesson about Finland swiftly yields to a church service that illuminates the scope of damage Katri's grandfather has taken at the hands of a bear prior Katri beginning her home commute when Martti intercepts her to signal an interest in a fishing trip to temper the news of no headway being made to learn of any job openings; unfortunately, Martti wanders into the wrath of his elder sister Mari whose deflection succeeds the ashes of the mission charged him.

episodes.title: Fermezza
episodes.synopsis: A typical quiet evening becomes the backdrop for an ordinary home commute with Juura to become extraordinary when Martii accosts Katri with the preamble to a viable job opportunity on the Räikkölä-ke farm along with the necessary vector to be added to the payrolls; as an additional unexpected bonus, Katri's grandfather Julius is in the neighborhood entreating Governor Halme that he be bailed some wheat; while licking his wounds from having his exhortation refused, Julius is forced to rethink his perspective on Katri working now faced with the prospect of there being no food at all and reluctantly agrees to accompany his granddaughter to Halme-ke the next day where the cobbler explains them the parameters of Räikkölä-ke's herding job.

episodes.title: La partenza
episodes.synopsis: Upon the affirmative reply arriving in record-breaking time and a lunch pack galvanized with her grandparents' sage counsel for the road, zero hour for Katri's journey to Räikkölä-ke with Aapeli is finally at hand!!! A chance encounter with the cobbler becomes the forum for Katri to have delivered unto her a syllabus of what to expect from Räikkölä-ke prior to Martii catching up to Katri; upon having explained the cobbler's counsel, Martii feels a little guilty about how things have turned out as he endures the physiological wages of the subterfuge that he has had to avail.

episodes.title: Il padrone
episodes.synopsis: The carriage ride with Pekka's derision as the salary quickly gives way to Katri finding nobody from Räikkölä-ke to greet her with instructions of what to do next; while shooing Aapeli outside, Katri runs into Anneli who finds it hilarious that the confused child mistakes her for the estate governess when she returns from furlough. Katri's confusion is only compounded when she finds the estate governess Ulla Räikkölä in the sauna making hotcakes apparently unable to focus on anything about her other than her fondness for Aapeli who has come upon a doghouse built near Katri's quarters perfect for housing the dachshund if Katri can get the estate governor Teemu Räikkölä to see things her way when he returns -- easier said than done when Teemu is in a bad mood and Aapeli is less than diplomatic with his volition for the doghouse!!! The ensuing caustic denigration of Aapeli is ultimately perverted to Teemu's detriment when Aapeli helps Katri to account for each and every cow during the cattle drive tomorrow; however, Teemu charging Katri flawless memorization of individual names and attributes proves far more daunting.

episodes.title: La padrona
episodes.synopsis: The previous ten days have affirmed quod erat demonstrandum what Ukonniemi-ke, Halme-ke, and now Teemu already know: Katri and Aapeli's prominent proficiency at herding cattle. When Katri finally has her lunch and is able to get going, Teemu charges her the guidance of the cattle to the southern pasture along with walking them five kilometers; while Katri enjoys the nice weather as she watches the cattle do their thing, Pekka comes over for a visit to appraise her status.

episodes.title: Un incidente
episodes.synopsis: Even though it should be clear that the safety of the cows is the alpha priority for which she was hired and that the errand Ulla charged her is an illegal order to never be complied, Katri dreads the prospect of Teemu purging her from the payrolls on Ulla's behalf if she stands her ground but also remembers having it explained that Ulla is not all there upstairs; commiserating Ulla's anguish for her late daughter Leena and reasoning that Aapeli alone is enough to keep the placid herd in check, Katri decides for the errand in spite of Aapeli's protests and oblivious to Pekka sensing a deviant diagnostic when she races by him.

episodes.title: La malattia
episodes.synopsis: Thanks to her collaborative efforts with Pekka, Katri successfully rescued all of the Räikkölä-ke cattle only to have endowed unto her a scathing castigation complete with a cane strike before Teemu has the true nature of the situation explained to him; still, Katri is in for quite a surprise when she finds herself inhibited by a cumbersome deviant diagnostic as the wages for her muddy intercession for Viikuna who had led the other bovines to the cliff at the north pasture in the first place.

episodes.title: Una promessa
episodes.synopsis: While Katri might have successfully dodged the bullet of adverse employment action from being sidelined with a cold due to Ulla coming to grips with the final agony of her daughter Leena, Martii Halme cannot escape the reality that he does not have the optimal configuration to successfully meet the hefty physiological demands of herding cattle like Katri does nor the stormy family politics he is forced to prosecute with Helena at home -- the commute thereof wielded as the backdrop of another impromptu geography lesson about Finland.

episodes.title: Un combattimento
episodes.synopsis: While his fatigued arms might digress quite vociferously, Martii Halme prosecutes his workday with the perspective that he is not wrong to have rushed across the lake to Räikkölä-ke where he has promised to herd the cows while Katri recuperates in spite of Helena's objections equally split between emphatic counsel to stay home and declaring her intention to blow the whistle to her family government; meanwhile, Ulla and Anneli prosecute a conversation about the latter's perspective of the former's recovery while the former having decided for housing Katri in the summer house charges the latter the refurbishment of a room to this effect.

episodes.title: La lettera
episodes.synopsis: A foggy morning becomes the ironic backdrop for Katri's illness to have completely resolved itself and for Aapeli to roam all over the Räikkölä farm barking up a storm much to Katri's chagrin when Ulla and Anneli are also awakened; while both ladies are grateful for the wake-up call, Teemu is not quite done sleeping as he directs Katri to work hard.

episodes.title: Il regalo
episodes.synopsis: Another ordinary afternoon of minding the herd in which Aapeli learns the hidden expense behind partaking in free samples becomes the backdrop for the university student Aki Ranta to walk into Katri's life searching for artistic inspiration as he explains about the Kalevala -- a copy of which Helena possesses and Martii seeks to bail himself for Katri's sake; while Helena explains how he has arrived in the countryside only a few days ago with his spouse with whom her mother is good friends, Aki explains Katri his prologue as a university student as he draws one of the cows along with availing Katri herself as a model.

episodes.title: L'invito
episodes.synopsis: Aki has done a wonderful thing by introducing the Kalevala to Katri and defeating the vindictiveness by which Helena expresses her clumsiness with that book; still, a little excavation will reveal that everything is not as hunky-dory as it initially appears when Aapeli is frustrated at having to do double duty since Katri is so engrossed in reading the Kalevala. Upon Pekka sharing his perspective of books being a headache for him, Katri remarks about the complicated portions that make sense with a little computation in most cases when Aki posing the question of what Pekka and Katri plan to do with their lives becomes the preamble of his discourse about the feeling of national pride galvanizing the Finnish people as they prepare to fight for their political independence from Russia; an impromptu tutoring session with Aki gives way to Teemu giving Katri a day off as thanks for Ulla's recovery. Martii arrives the next day with the news that Julius and Hilda are doing well for themselves along with that he has secured some books for Katri to read; while Pekka digests the food for thought of Martii playing with Aapeli, Martii returns back home to find Aki sending off his mother on her journey back to Turku. Upon hearing that Katri has Sunday off and realizing that Katri is not going to enjoy being around Helena, Aki suggesting that Martii and Katri spend time with him at his villa becomes the ultimate backdrop for the two kids to learn that insulting criminal laws with destructive conduct is not the only route to being arrested . . . the sole prerequisite is to gently rock the boat; much to Martti and Katri's horror, Aki's political activities are making the prospect of capsizing in a heavy storm an imminent and intimidating prospect for the Russians!!!

episodes.title: La paga inaspettata
episodes.synopsis: Morning breaks unto the Räikkölä farm when Teemu charges Katri guidance of the cattle to the north pasture where she and Pekka had to combine efforts to rescue the cattle that wandered too close to the steep cliff there and could not arrest their descent down the precarious terrain of the slope; realizing that she could have had hefty fatality ratios for nothing more than a careless error, Katri foregoes reading to endow extra vigilance unto the wayward Viikuna not realizing that Martti has been searching for her because he has to return back to his urban home. Pekka explaining Martii the presence of multiple pastures igniting a fast friendship between the two boys obfuscates Katri endeavoring to understand why Aki had been arrested as she holds the Kalevala in her hand -- the quandary that becomes the forum for Martii to deliver Katri the bad news. Viikuna's curiosity punctuates Martti and Katri's personal perspective comparison exercise before Martii's cousin Helena arrives to relay that the departure time has been moved up along with taking one last contemptuous dig at Katri. An upcoming thunderstorm becomes the ultimate forum for Katri to receive a new dress from Ulla along with the opportunity to some spend more time with Martti; as an unexpected bonus, Katri is also blessed with courier commerce courtesy of Martti who is combining efforts with Pekka to mind the herd.

episodes.title: La pecora smarrita
episodes.synopsis: An ordinary afternoon of minding the herd on the north pasture where Katri feels that she can work on reading the Kalevala without having an incident on her hands becomes the preamble for a novel discovery -- neither Viikuna leading the other cows over the cliff nor Aapeli giving chase after a curious fox -- but rather a lost lamb grazing on the pasture that Pekka denies is a Penttilä asset. Katri leading the cattle back to the Räikkölä farm sets the stage for a soliloquy about the climate patterns of Finland whose most prominent feature Aapeli demonstrates as he repels a pack of hungry wolves stalking the herd during the home commute -- forest fauna not being as reluctant to venture into the open. Back at the ranch, the little lamb quickly becomes the talk of the town when Katri has it explained that she will most likely end up as the sheep's owner considering the circumstances defined by Teemu who gives Katri the syllabus of her duties the next day where she unsuccessfully tries to emulate the bundling techniques of the adults. Ulla brings lunch out to everybody and signals an interest in having Aapeli's company while out on the town but finds that the dachshund is more interested in catching the fox that previously eluded him. Unfortunately, for Katri, Aapeli is ultimately not the only one with a score to settle as the pack of wolves Aapeli repelled earlier decide to try for the sheep in spite of Katri's fierce opposition; a lengthy battle and a nocturnal escort home courtesy of Vihtori later, Katri enjoys a hearty and well-earned meal after reading a letter that Martti has decided to apply himself academically.
